key_points: Longer iPhone 18 Pro delivery times indicate healthy launch demand, though not clearly above prior-year norms.
The $1,999 foldable iPhone could lift average selling prices and renew hardware growth, but adoption remains unproven.
Memory shortages and price increases may support revenue per unit while risking lower volumes and margin pressure.
Apple Pay's India launch adds incremental services growth; the settlement and Fitness+ cuts are financially immaterial.
Record-high valuation and an analyst price-target cut limit near-term upside.
